title: Almost Heaven Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Experience the Joys of ‘Almost Heaven’ This comfy cottage is decorated with Boho beach style! Floor to ceiling tongue and groove white walls and flooring are complemented by matte black hardware and fixtures.
description_expanded: Description99 TUPELO STREET1 KING, 1 QUEEN, 2 TWIN, QUEEN SLEEPER SOFAFeatured in The Cottage Journal – Summer 2020Tucked just off Tupelo Circle in the heart of Seaside, Florida, this beautifully renovated beach cottage blends relaxed coastal living with elevated Boho beach style. Thoughtfully curated with natural textures and calming tones, the home features floor-to-ceiling white tongue-and-groove paneling, light wood floors, matte black fixtures, sisal rugs, and crisp white linens—creating an atmosphere that feels effortlessly stylish yet deeply inviting.Coastal Design Meets Everyday ComfortThe recently updated kitchen and primary bathroom showcase a fresh, modern coastal aesthetic with farmhouse sinks, floating shelves, shell stone flooring, and warm teak accents. Carefully selected furnishings and lighting reinforce the home’s laid-back, bohemian charm while maintaining a polished, magazine-worthy feel.Outdoor living spaces include a screened-in front porch with a classic Southern swing and a private gazebo, offering peaceful spots to relax, read, or enjoy the coastal breeze.Open Living & Entertaining SpacesInside, the main living area offers generous seating, a 72-inch flat-screen TV, and a queen sleeper sofa, providing flexibility for additional guests. The dining room centers around a farmhouse table with bench seating for eight, beautifully illuminated by oversized sea-grass pendant lights. Additional seating at the bay window and kitchen bar makes this space ideal for family meals or casual gatherings. A newly renovated half bath with shell stone floors and glass pendant lighting is conveniently located on the first floor.Three Private Bedroom SuitesUpstairs, the home features three bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, offering comfort and privacy for all guests.Primary Suite: Vaulted ceilings, a king bed, abundant natural light, flat-screen TV, walk-in closet, and a spa-inspired bath with a glass shower and teak finishesQueen Bedroom: Bright and welcoming with bay windows and a private bath with shower/tub combinationTwin Bedroom: Two twin beds, private bath, and flat-screen TV—perfect for additional guestsA hallway washer and dryer, storage closet, and luggage rack add everyday convenience.Iconic Tower ViewsOne of the home’s most memorable features is the third-level tower, accessed via a ship ladder. From this elevated perch, enjoy sweeping views of the Gulf of Mexico and the charming rooftops of Seaside. Whether catching a golden sunset or listening to the waves roll in, this special space delivers unforgettable moments in one of Florida’s most beloved beach communities.No children under 10* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,783 square feet352 yards / 4-minute walk to Tupelo Beach PavilionSeaside Private Residential Beach – largest private beach on 30AWasher & dryerPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughoutAccess to Seaside amenities: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued (Golf carts are considered vehicles. Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners (permits required for medical needs))No pets STR23-002039
